common.slogan: Lost something at UM? Just miaUM.

footer.about: Lost and found for the University of Minho community. It points items to the official drop-off points and protects everyone's privacy.
footer.independent: Independent project. Not an official University of Minho service.
footer.provisional: Development version: drop-off points and opening hours are example data.

home.title: University of Minho lost and found
home.intro: Found something or lost something on campus? Post it here and we'll help get it back to its owner, simply and safely.

1.title: Post
1.text: Whoever loses or finds an item describes it, the campus and the place.

2.title: We find matches
2.text: The app suggests similar posts automatically and notifies the owner.

3.title: Collect it safely
3.text: The owner claims the item and is told where to pick it up.

home.privacyText: The public only sees where and when an item was found. The drop-off location and contacts are revealed only to the person who claims it.
home.emptyText: Lost and found posts will appear here.
home.oldNotice: Lost something more than 30 days ago? Ask directly at the drop-off points.
home.howText: Three steps to get an item back to its owner.

login.title: Sign in to miaUM
login.intro: Use your university email. We'll send you a link that expires in 15 minutes, no password needed.
login.checkText: If the email is valid, you'll receive a sign-in link. It may take a few minutes; check your spam folder too.
login.checkHint: You can close this page. The link opens the app already signed in.

errors.AccessDenied: This email can't be used. Please use your university email.
errors.Verification: The link has expired or was already used. Request a new one.
errors.limite: Too many links requested. Try again in an hour.
errors.default: Couldn't sign you in. Please try again.

account.title: My account
account.description: The data we keep about you: only your first name and email.
account.name: Name

staff.title: Staff panel
staff.description: Items handed in at your points will appear here, with pick-up actions.
staff.noPoints: You're not assigned to any drop-off point yet
staff.noPointsText: Ask an administrator to assign you to a point.
staff.itemsSoon: The item list arrives in the next phase.

admin.title: Administration
admin.toolsSoon: Managing points, roles and moderation arrives in Phase 4.

errors.forbiddenText: You don't have permission to see this page.

errors.genericText: An unexpected error occurred. Please try again.

report.lostText: Here you will be able to describe the item you lost and get notified when something similar turns up.
report.foundText: Here you will be able to post the item you found and see the nearest drop-off points.
report.soonTitle: The form arrives in the next phase
report.soonText: We are building this part of miaUM. Meanwhile, if you found an item, please hand it in at an official point.
